coverage.main: Read all ten pages of arXiv 2211.09773v1 (16 November 2022; CVPR 2023 paper): Sections 1-5, Algorithm 1, Tables 1-5, Figures 1-6 and references. The CVPR open-access version and any CVF supplement were not retrieved separately.
coverage.supplement: No appendix is embedded; a CVF supplement was not located or read.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box columns of Tables 1-3 (detector used to optimise the patch); gray, random-noise and white patches in Table 3 are non-adversarial controls; figures are qualitative or ablation plots of the same metric.

result_groups.population: INRIA test set (288 images), COCO-person (1,684 images) and CCTV-person (559 images); universal person-hiding patches trained on one detector (INRIA train) and evaluated on the other seven detectors
result_groups.outcome: mAP of black-box detectors, with each detector's clean-image predictions treated as ground truth (clean mAP = 1)
result_groups.evidence: The outcome is defined relative to each detector's own clean predictions over the full test sets, so a clean-correct event is not defined, and a universal patch has no per-image source-success rule.

f1.evidence: Clean predictions are the reference (mAP = 1 by construction), so no separate clean accuracy exists for this outcome.

f2.evidence: Detection mAP has no per-image clean-correct event.

f3.evidence: No source-success rule applies to a universal patch.

f5.evidence: A 300 x 300 adversarial patch at scale 0.15 without an Lp radius; an explicit design, as for rank 14.

f6.evidence: The official repository provides training and evaluate.py for the detectors; datasets are public. Detector weights and trained patches were not verified. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper. Listed via the GitHub API (608 files, head 11 October 2024): evaluate.py, train_optim.py, train_fgsm.py and detector libraries. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: Detection mAP relative to clean predictions is not a misclassification probability.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit; fields 1-4 are unclear because of the detection outcome, as for rank 14.
